params.name: Skitter Dart
params.note: The light racer: the Twinspool cut down, small turbines with chrome intake spikes, in crop-sprayer green and white. Generated from mesh_podracer.json (scale it there, then re-cut); its sizes are PODRACER_TYPES.skitter in podracer-model.js.

parts.name: pod body
parts.note: The Twinspool's pod, scaled to this one.

parts.name: pod
parts.note: The cockpit tub, sized for the seat: about 3.2 m long and 1.3 m across at 7.2 m to the unit, the ground seats' metre. Its nose tip is the ring both cables meet at.

parts.name: cockpit opening
parts.note: The open top of the tub, dark, round the driver.

parts.name: coaming roll
parts.note: Oxblood leather rolled round the cockpit opening.

parts.name: pod flanks
parts.note: Rails, strakes, vents, fins, thrusters, mirrors and marker lamps, both sides.

parts.name: flank rail
parts.note: A chrome rail down the flank, the pod's grab rail and rubbing strake.

parts.name: tail fin
parts.note: A canted fin on the tail, for looks and a little weathervane.

parts.name: roll hoop
parts.note: A chrome hoop behind the helmet.

parts.name: spine fairing
parts.note: The headrest fairing, tapering down the spine to the tail.

parts.name: kit:canards
parts.note: Pod wings (podracer kit wings=canard): a carbon canard each side of the nose, trim-tipped.

parts.name: latch:fins
parts.note: The docking latch: a blade each side that slides out of the pod (podStow 0) into the socket on the docked turbine's inner face, and back in (podStow 1, how it rests) when the turbines launch.

parts.name: turbine
parts.note: Built round its own centre and moved out to the rest pose. Everything in it, the half of the binder included, is the R piece, and the L piece on the other side.

parts.name: casing
parts.note: Bare aluminium, the intake dark inside a chrome lip; the hot end is its own section.

parts.name: hot section
parts.note: Heat-tinted steel from the turbine stages back to the nozzle: straw where it leaves the casing, through bronze and purple to blue, and soot at the lip (the burnt slot ramp).

parts.name: tail cone
parts.note: The exhaust cone in the middle of the nozzle, so the back of the turbine reads as a turbine and not a lid.

parts.name: flame ring
parts.note: The hot ring round the tail cone.

parts.name: casing seam
parts.note: The flange where the casing meets the hot section.

parts.name: fan
parts.note: The first stage, fourteen twisted blades behind the intake lip, so the intake reads as a turbine and not a hole.

parts.name: binder emitter
parts.note: A short arm toward the other turbine, ending in the emitter; the energy binder arcs across the gap between the two (drawPodracerArc in windshield.js). Torn, the arc goes and the arms stay.

parts.name: emitter cup
parts.note: The chrome cup the arc leaves from.

parts.name: emitter coil
parts.note: A copper winding round the arm behind the cup.

parts.name: binder collar
parts.note: A polished clamp where the binder half meets the casing.

parts.name: air brake 45
parts.note: A petal of the air brake, hinged at its front edge; it swings out into the air while the brake is held (channel airbrake). Brushed outside, candy inside, so it flashes red when it opens.

parts.name: air brake 135
parts.note: A petal of the air brake, hinged at its front edge; it swings out into the air while the brake is held (channel airbrake). Brushed outside, candy inside, so it flashes red when it opens.

parts.name: air brake 225
parts.note: A petal of the air brake, hinged at its front edge; it swings out into the air while the brake is held (channel airbrake). Brushed outside, candy inside, so it flashes red when it opens.

parts.name: air brake 315
parts.note: A petal of the air brake, hinged at its front edge; it swings out into the air while the brake is held (channel airbrake). Brushed outside, candy inside, so it flashes red when it opens.

parts.name: intake duct
parts.note: The inside of the intake, behind the lip: dark, narrowing to the fan.

parts.name: intake spike
parts.note: A long chrome spike out of the spinner: the Skitter Dart's mark.

parts.name: hifi:trim band
parts.note: A painted band round the casing behind the intake: the trim colour on the turbines.

parts.name: kit:afterburner can
parts.note: Jet pipes (podracer kit pipes=long): the can carries the nozzle a turbine-radius further aft; the plume starts at its lip.

parts.name: latch:socket
parts.note: Where the pod's latch blade goes in when the turbine docks beside it.
